final: WITH t AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), s AS (SELECT archstat, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM t) AS share FROM t) SELECT archstat, cnt AS tally, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS above_average FROM s WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s)
